A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''doctor''' was a member of the [[Imperial Medical Corps]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], and he was sent to the ruins of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to tend to the survivors of [[Darth Malgus]]'s strike team.
